Worlds.dc.html.title: Worlds: list, upload, new, every stage

Palette.dc.html.title: Command palette, notifications, update coming soon, dim sum

n_main.text:
Editor workspace. Shows the panel layout: tab strip docked left with Close and Open every tab, map, Fill tool, floating Block palette group, floating toolbar, snackbar.
Try: Tweaks dark, showFloat, showDrop, seed, motion; click tabs, tools, toolbar modes.
In the app: panels, map, the five tools, history, notes, language chips. Also: structure files (.nbt save and place, undoable), the Blocks panel and the floating map toolbar with Pan, Select, Pick block, Measure and Go to. Not in the app yet: per-element appearance.

n_worlds.text:
Worlds screen with every stage. Try: Tweak stage (list, loading, empty, upload, error, offline), dark, seed, motion.
Stands for: upload a world .zip to the web app or appliance, new flat world, download .zip, browse a folder in the desktop app.
Being built; nothing here is verified in the app until the handoff says so.

n_firstrun.text:
First-run wizard. Try: click steps, Back, Next, Skip, language cards; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for the in-app onboarding wizard: language and voice, comfort modes, theme colour, open a world; progress saves and resumes.
Being built; the owner account already exists as the sign-up screen.

n_history.text:
Edit history. Try: action filter chips, select a point; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for the private Git history kept beside app data, append-only restore.
In the app: Edits and Details panels with their own saved layout, list, search, From and To dates, action filters with counts, shown count, details with full commit id, roll back, copy commit id. Also: Open as a copy, per-point stats and an Activity panel (accounts, settings, extensions, worlds; also with no world open).

n_settings.text:
Settings. Try: an Account and passkeys section, palette teleport to every setting, section tabs, language buttons, switches, seed swatches; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: an Account and passkeys section, palette teleport to every setting, section tabs, settings search across sections, language, both funny sliders, dark, theme colour picker, reduce motion, large text, sound effects with volume and a test sound, export, import, settings history with Restore, Clear buttons on every text field, read messages aloud with speed and a test, dark theme on a schedule, Lock editing, Extensions section. Also: a lock on every switch (locked switches are disabled here and refused in the palette), Quiet hours for sounds and reading aloud. Also: Lock panel layout, Keep every tab open, Lock the Settings screen with an Unlock banner. Emoji in dialogs switch: not needed, the app uses drawn icons instead of emoji in its dialogs.

n_regexbuilder.text:
Every search field in the app: plain text by default, .* turns regex on for that field only, the builder sits beside it. Try: .* switch, builder button, presets (Invalid and Too slow show the error states), insert tokens, flags; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: settings, history, changelog and palette searches; worker-isolated ECMAScript engine with 250 ms stop; raw pattern and field synced both ways; flags i m s u; sample with highlights and capture groups; copy and export; nothing saved. Also: Find tabs with its own builder, Close tabs containing text and Close tabs not containing text (one predicate, count, preview, empty and invalid queries refused, last tab and running edits kept). Also: the board's ready-made pattern chips (Starts with Fill or Replace, Sizes, Commit ids, Block names, Dates); the demo-only Invalid and Too slow chips stay on the board.

n_extensions.text:
Extensions manager in Settings. Try: switch Spawn platform on to see the consent dialog, Cancel or Allow; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: manifest.json v1 per folder, out-of-process JSON-lines protocol, permissions world-info, selection, edit-world with consent tied to the exact set (changes ask again), 10 s and 1 MiB limits, clean environment with no secrets or paths, edits through the recorded history path, searchable manager with its own regex builder, palette commands, two built-in extensions, author article with Node and Python samples, master switch, add from .zip (and from a folder in the desktop app) asking before replacing, remove, reload, open extensions folder, recent runs, consent again on any version or permission change. Also: Add from link (https .zip). Also: Add from link checks an optional published SHA-256 and reports the download's SHA-256. Not yet: code-signed extension sources.

n_palette.text:
Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+F) with live setting rows, notification centre, Update coming soon, dim sum surprise. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: palette with live switches and its own regex builder, notification centre, update flow: background download shown in About, ready-to-install banner with version, release notes, unsigned note, Later and Restart. Dim sum surprise in the app: 1 in 10 at start after setup, corner card with bilingual name, jyutping and description from the public catalogue, Public image unavailable placeholder (photos are only published encrypted), closes after 9 s unless hovered, switch in Settings and palette. Also: the Update coming soon card with an indeterminate bar and Hide while the download runs, in the editor and the deploy app.

n_takeover.text:
Install success and failure takeovers for the deploy app. Try: Tweak state, seed, motion.
In the deploy app: both takeovers as drawn. Success: link, version, time taken, Open, Copy link, closes after 8 s unless hovered or focused. Failure: stays, step log with the exact error, Try port N+1 when the port is taken (else Try again), Copy details, Dismiss; focus kept inside, Esc closes. The editor app uses the same shared takeover for world uploads (Ready to edit, Open in the editor; failure with the exact reason, Choose another, Copy details), switchable in Settings › Comfort.

n_phone.text:
Phone width: panels collapse to one group with chips; bottom destinations. Try: panel chips, destinations; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: one tabbed panel group under 720 px with its own saved layout, compact header, bottom destinations with icon pills. Also: the panel chips row (a tab list with arrow keys) replaces the group's own tab strip on phones.

n_deploy.text:
Deploy app. Try: target cards, Deploy and Instances views; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: Docker, Docker on another computer over SSH (DOCKER_HOST=ssh, own key, no passwords), VirtualBox and USB flash targets, Raspberry Pi pointing to the SSH route, instance list with Manage, success and failure takeovers. Real-world checks after every release: Docker local and over SSH (deploy, health, stop, start, restart, update, live log, remove) and USB flash with read-back passed on real Docker and a loop device; the Windows app updated itself from the previous release. Also: VMware Workstation or Player (ovftool import on a bridged network, vmrun start without a window, address from the guest tools, manage). Pi image built in CI (Pi 4 and 5), container checked for arm64, booted on QEMU raspi4b to the health check (not yet on a physical Pi) and offered through USB drive. Also: Duplicate on a Docker instance (same computer, version and worlds, suggested free name and port, fresh accounts; virtual machines explain why not).

n_deploymanage.text:
Deploy app instance management. Try: Tweak state (running, stopped, restarting), dark, seed, motion.
Stands for Open, Start or Stop, Restart, Update and Remove on a Docker instance the app created, plus a live log that follows docker compose logs.
Being built for the Docker target; not run against a real Docker host.

n_about.text:
About and changelog. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Stands for version provenance from the running build and a changelog generated from the real commit history at build time, each entry with its SHA, searchable.
Being built; the regex builder beside the search is not built.

n_tour.text:
Guided Take a tour: coach card beside the real control with a highlight ring, Step N of M, Back, Skip this step, Next, Close. Try: Back, Skip, Next, Close; Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
In the app: whole-app tour plus one per destination (Worlds, Editor, History, Settings, About), offered once after onboarding, reachable from the ? Help menu, Settings › Comfort and the palette, resumes where it stopped, focus moves to the control, Esc and arrow keys, screen-reader announcement, reduced motion, English and Cantonese. Steps whose control is off screen say so and offer to reveal it. The deploy app and the docs site have their own tours with the same card. Also: the appliance console shows a four-step text tour under its version and link (a console has no pointer to anchor a coach card).

n_sitehome.text:
Docs site home on GitHub Pages. Tweaks dark, seed, motion.
Built and deployed to match this board. Also: bundled fonts, favicon, article screenshots for the newest features. Also: the animated hero demo (select, fill, roll back; still under reduced motion). Not yet: phone PDF edition.
